integrity.mathematical_checks: same-model proof reconstruction and finite independent graph-spine verification
integrity.publication_priority: provisional; potentially implicit in broader equivariant configuration constructions

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns unordered distinct particles on a finite equal-arm star, and actions that permute arms while retaining radial coordinates.
The classical nonequivariant radial-tree homotopy and rank results are used and credited; the all-subgroup fixed-space product decomposition and generating functions are the new claim.
The finite graph-spine verification does not prove the general theorem or exclude unindexed equivalent prior work.
No result for general tree fixed spaces with arbitrarily many particles or for orbit quotients is asserted.
title: All-particle subgroup-fixed configurations of star graphs
